name: Alex Example
summary: Backend engineer building customer-facing services, reliable data workflows, and practical operational tools across logistics products, field-service integrations, and embedded systems.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Moved long-running shipment quote requests from serverless functions to browser-direct streaming, preserving server-side audit logs and usage capture while removing the function timeout constraint.

Replaced opaque shipment manifest blobs with a relational line-item model in PostgreSQL, using migration checkpoints to support customs notes, attachments, quality review, and export without losing existing records.

Defined versioned event contracts across six product domains and generated TypeScript and Go clients, giving application developers a shared interface for publishing events and validating incoming messages.
Investigated duplicate billing events during concurrent retries, added transaction boundaries around ledger updates, and documented recovery procedures so support could reconcile affected accounts.

Reviewed rollout plans with product and support engineers, specified compatibility checks for older clients, and introduced a staged release checklist that made ownership and rollback decisions explicit.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built and operated scheduling and billing integrations for technician dispatch, translating inconsistent vendor APIs into customer workflows while preserving authorization checks and handling upstream service failures.

Owned dispatch-platform rollouts across hundreds of contractors, including groups with twenty depots, coordinating device provisioning, route configuration, test jobs, customer acceptance, and staged production launches.

Instrumented job routing and integration failures with structured logs and service dashboards, then used incident reviews to improve runbooks and catch repeated configuration problems before deployments.

Traced intermittent booking failures across vendor connectors, normalized inconsistent error responses, and added retry limits so customers received clear fallback instructions with the context operators needed.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Integrated C++ and Qt components into an agricultural sensor gateway, using a finite-state machine and interprocess communication to coordinate radio and cellular uploads as connectivity changed.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Implemented REST integrations with ticketing and identity services, and built authenticated AWS upload flows with CloudFront delivery so customers could publish event assets through the existing application interface.

projects.name: Example Application Tracker
bullets: Directed an agent-built implementation, owning architecture, isolation boundaries, and release approval for its CLI, read-only web interface, and document pipeline against explicit acceptance criteria.
Ships a rollback-safe deploy step, CI-gated migrations, and an error-reporting client that other example services import, with an ownership statement per package.
